rules: Never commit secrets, tokens, or raw messenger IDs to the repository; keys/ is gitignored and stored in the vault only.
Keep real member names and internal records strictly inside private group ADK instances; public templates use role-word placeholders only.
Use git for source control and track tasks via work documents in docs/work/ (document ID = work ID, front matter 마일스톤: and 기한:, and ## 할 일 table).
Each agent seat is a folder agents/<id>-adk/ with index.md inside (agents/<id>-adk/index.md).
Require explicit human approval before production changes, billing/payments, or external communications.
Never mix memory, credentials, or data across different groups.
